title: Attribution line
description: The tracer's finding for one feedback line: the step where the error began (origin), the steps that only passed it on (carriers), the cause, a confidence and alternatives. JSON Lines, UTF-8, append-only, stored at <product>/.po/attributions.jsonl. The latest line for an id is its current state: when the user confirms or rejects an attribution, or the tracer revises it, po appends a full new line with the same id. Each attribution also gets a register line of type attribution (register.schema.json).

x-causes.question-not-asked: The information needed was never asked for. The stage's question bank or the producer's steps had no question for it.
x-causes.answer-misheard: The user answered, but the answer was recorded or read with a different meaning.
x-causes.unsupported-inference: An agent inferred or assumed it without enough basis, or tagged an inference as Stated.
x-causes.skill-gap: The skill the agent followed had no rule for this, or a rule that led it wrong.
x-causes.reviewer-miss: A reviewer had a check that should have caught it and passed it. Usually the alternative or the should_have_caught, not the origin, because reviewers do not write items.
x-causes.template-gap: The template had no place for it, or its structure pushed the agent the wrong way.
x-causes.ignored-decision: A locked decision, answer or assumption in the register was there and was not followed.
x-causes.input-changed: The output matched what the user said at the time; the user or the source has since changed. A product correction, not a learning.
x-causes.client-preference: The output is fine in general, but this client wants it another way. Belongs in the client's preference profile.
x-causes.unknown: No cause can be named from the trace. Confidence is low and po asks the user one question.

id.description: AT-<number>, numbered per product in order from AT-001.

agent.description: tracer, or po for a line that only records the user's verdict.

origin.description: The earliest step where the error is already present.

carriers.description: Later steps that only passed the error on: their output was right given their input. In order, from the origin towards the item the feedback is about.

explanation.description: One or two sentences: what went wrong at the origin and why, as conditions, not blame.

confidence.description: High 0.8 or more: one node where the error first appears, a source mismatch, and replay confirms. Medium 0.5 to under 0.8: clear chain, no replay or an inconclusive one. Low under 0.5: several candidates; po asks the user one question before anything is proposed.

basis.description: The evidence: trace lines, register lines and file lines read.

replay.description: Whether the origin step was re-run in a scratch folder with the correction, and whether the item then came out right. Never run against the products repo.

should_have_caught.description: The reviewer agent that should have caught it, if any.

question_for_user.description: Required in practice when confidence is under 0.5 or the category is not-sure: the one question po asks the user.

suggested_surface.description: Where a fix would most likely go. A hint for /po-retro, not a decision.

user_verdict.description: null until the user has seen it.

step.description: One agent step, as recorded in the trace. item_id and rev name the item it wrote, when there is one; a process problem may have none.
